blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman has affirmed its decision to impose a six-month preventive suspension without pay on Dalaguete, Cebu Mayor Ronald Allan Cesante and five municipal officials over alleged irregularities in the construction of a municipal warehouse. In a statement on Sunday, the Ombudsman said it had dismissed the motion for reconsideration filed by Cesante and the five other respondents against its Aug. 29, 2025, decision ordering their preventive suspension.
